title: Recording agreement with costs deducted before royalties

standard_clauses.heading: Parties
standard_clauses.text: This Recording Agreement is made between the Artist and the Company on the Effective Date stated at the end of this Agreement.

standard_clauses.heading: Term
standard_clauses.text: The Term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for two (2) years, unless it is terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement.

standard_clauses.heading: Grant of Rights
standard_clauses.text: The Artist grants to the Company a non-exclusive licence to record, reproduce, distribute and exploit the Recordings during the Term in Kenya. All rights not expressly granted are reserved by the Artist.

standard_clauses.heading: Ownership
standard_clauses.text: The Company owns the master recordings created under this Agreement. The Artist retains ownership of the musical compositions and the right to receive royalties.

standard_clauses.heading: Royalties
standard_clauses.text: The Company shall pay the Artist a royalty of twenty per cent (20%) of Gross Receipts from the exploitation of the Recordings.

standard_clauses.heading: Payment Dates
standard_clauses.text: Within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, the Company shall send the Artist a statement. The Company shall pay the royalties shown in that statement within fifteen (15) days after the statement date.

standard_clauses.heading: Accounting
standard_clauses.text: The Company shall keep complete books and records of Gross Receipts and shall allow the Artist to inspect them once each year on reasonable notice.

standard_clauses.heading: Exclusivity
standard_clauses.text: During the Term, the Artist shall work exclusively with the Company for the recording and release of the Recordings and shall not grant the same rights to any other label.

standard_clauses.heading: Termination
standard_clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement on thirty (30) days written notice if the other party commits a material breach and does not cure it within that period.

standard_clauses.heading: Renewal
standard_clauses.text: The parties may renew this Agreement for a further period only by a written agreement signed by both parties.

standard_clauses.heading: Governing Law
standard_clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya and the courts of Kenya have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute about it.

standard_clauses.heading: Notices
standard_clauses.text: Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered to the addresses given by the parties in clause 1.1.

standard_clauses.heading: Entire Agreement
standard_clauses.text: This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about the Recordings and replaces all earlier understandings on that subject.

risks.description: Recording, marketing and other costs are deducted before the royalty is calculated, reducing the artist's share.
